WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

A guide to the live game, levels 1 to 60, checked against client 1.60.1.70938 on November 13, 2026. Talent rows open at 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40, one point a level from 10, 51 points at 60. The one-point talents are gated on points spent in the tree, not on level. Talent rows, ranks and numbers are read from the client. Blizzard's September 30 Class Deep Dive, its November 2 notes and its launch hotfixes outrank the client and the guide sites. Every talent build below is a published one, named and dated. WoWSims is a model and is named as one wherever it is used. The dungeon-healing section rests on one creator's video and says so. No raid opens before December 9, 2026, so the level-60 builds rest on their authors' judgement and on no raid log. Where a tooltip differs from the text, go by the text: tooltips can lag a hotfix.

What Shadow is for

The damage a Priest does not otherwise get, and healing as a by-product of it. Mind FlayMind FlayLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration3 secAssault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%. is the channelled filler no other tree has. Vampiric EmbraceVampiric EmbraceLevel 30 · Spell · ShadowCastInstantCost40 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration30 secAfflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec. heals every party member for 20% of the Shadow damage you deal to the marked target. ShadowformShadowformSpell · ShadowCastInstantCost40% of base ManaCooldown1.5 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAssume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form. halves your Shadow Mana costs and doubles your Shadow crit bonus.

Icy Veins' ratings: Overall 3.5, Levelling 3.0, Dungeon 2.5, Utility 5.0, Mobility 1.0. The levelling number measures solo kill speed and nothing else. Its own summary of the levelling curve:

"In lower levels, Shadow has a complicated leveling curve. The spec is incredibly reliant on Spirit TapSpirit TapTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantGives you a 100% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting. for its mana regeneration. Failing to get last hits on enemies will generally lead you to drinking more often."

It gets better three times. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting. whoever lands the blow. At ShadowformShadowformSpell · ShadowCastInstantCost40% of base ManaCooldown1.5 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAssume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form. the Mana curve improves "drastically", in Icy Veins' word. Wowhead lists the cost of that last one as a con: "Substantial power locked behind the level 40 talent".

Land the killing blow. Spirit TapSpirit TapTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantGives you a 100% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting. is your Mana economy while levelling. It has a 20% chance a rank to fire when you kill a target that gives experience, or when an enemy carrying your Vampiric EmbraceVampiric EmbraceLevel 30 · Spell · ShadowCastInstantCost40 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration30 secAfflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec. dies. It doubles your Spirit for 15 seconds and lets half your regeneration continue while you cast.

A respec is a trainer visit. Icy Veins puts the first at 1 gold, rising each time. Dual Specialization is bought from the class trainer at level 40 for 50 gold (Wowhead's report; Blizzard gives the level and no price).

Healing dungeons as Shadow

Before 40 you are a Priest with every healing spell, and Shadow talents cost you little. Icy Veins and Wowhead both note that a levelling Shadow Priest often heals early dungeons.

Past 40, one creator reports healing dungeons from inside ShadowformShadowformSpell · ShadowCastInstantCost40% of base ManaCooldown1.5 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAssume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. Stat priority

While levelling, Icy Veins' order: Spell Power, critical strike, Hit, Intellect, Spirit, Stamina, MP5.

Hit sits low while levelling: "While fighting enemies at your level, you'll need very little hit chance." An enemy two levels above you is a 6% miss.

At 60, Icy Veins' order: Hit to 17%, Spell Power, critical strike, Spell Pierce, Spirit.

At 60, Wowhead's order: Hit to 17%, critical strike, Spell Damage, Intellect, Spirit, Stamina. Wowhead labels its list speculative and wrote it before launch.

They agree on Hit and differ on what comes second. A caster misses a raid boss 17% of the time. Shadow FocusShadow FocusTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%. 5/5 covers 5, so gear has to find 12%. At level 60

The published builds are settled; their value is not measured. Wowhead, Icy Veins and WoWSims all sit on 15/3/33, and Wowhead calls its own build speculative. Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair open on December 9, 2026, so no raid log exists.

No debuff limit. Icy Veins states that Forever has no cap on debuffs per target, so your damage-over-time spells are not competing for slots.
